Fleet Services

Fleet Management

Run trucks, trailers, assets, and driver workflows from one TTMS control layer. Keep uptime high, costs visible, and safety standards consistent across every shift.

Open Service

Truck Tracking

Track every truck in motion with precise location, route progress, and delay context. Give dispatch and customer teams one trusted feed for operational decisions.

Open Service

Trailer Tracking

Know trailer location, assignment status, and utilization in real time. Reduce trailer loss, cut dwell time, and keep dispatch decisions dependable.

Open Service

Asset Tracking

Track high-value tools, containers, and support assets with the same discipline as trucks. Keep operations ready and avoid expensive replacement cycles.

Open Service

Dispatch & Routing

Dispatch Management

Coordinate loads, drivers, and fleet status from one dispatch workspace. Reduce manual handoffs and keep teams aligned on every move.

Open Service

Smart Routing

Build routes that balance delivery speed, driver safety, and operating cost. TTMS adjusts plans with live road context and service priorities.

Open Service

Route Optimization

Continuously optimize fleet routes using real performance data. Eliminate avoidable miles, reduce delays, and improve trip consistency across your network.

Open Service

Load Planning

Plan loads with full visibility into equipment availability, delivery windows, and customer constraints. Keep execution smooth from tender to delivery confirmation.

Open Service

AI DashCams

Driver Monitoring

Safety Solutions

Performance Metrics

Fuel Alerts

Open Service
